body:
Quite a while has passed since the last release, and a fair few changes have been made so it's about time for another release.

## What's Changed
* Correction of minor typos for Russian localization by @dimuska139 in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2194
* Enable the use of AyatanaAppIndicator by @EbonJaeger in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2200
* Prevent the use of non-image files as a background image (replaces #2206) by @0scvr in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2207
* Allow splitting with specified size using --split-vertical or --split-horizontal by @welhoilija in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2208
* docs: update website URLs, use https:// by @ulidtko in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2239
* chore: update hu language 🇭🇺 by @Swiftyhu in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2240
* Remove underlines from quick-open targets when quick-open disabled by @chrhansk in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2235
* Makefile: ensure that schema source files are in place before schema recompilation occurs by @jayaddison in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2257
* Fix save content with newer Vte by @smith-doug in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2218
* Updates to CI by @Davidy22 in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2272
* Fix window position drift during visibility toggles by @xai in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2290

## New Contributors

* @xai made their first contribution in https://github.com/Guake/guake/pull/2290

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Guake/guake/compare/3.10...3.10.1
